authority.anchor: Owner authorizes offline analysis only, not paid runs or settings changes.

lineage.anchor: Report is historical; current adapter peak context is unmeasured.

drift.anchor: Changing prompts during model comparison confounds route evidence.

recommendation.anchor: No route recommendation until current usage and context evidence are measured under approval.

tradeoffs.anchor: Cheap route lowers historical cost but local quality is unknown.
Strong route has higher external score but local context is unknown.
